name: App icon — the silent one
description: The game's emblem, for a home screen: the player's own body seen against the soil a run happens in. Everything in this world announces itself by scent, so the frame is washed pink from behind — a bloom of pheromone rising out of the earth, seams of it along the strata, a pool of it on the ground — and the one object in the middle of all that is sealed, pale and silent, with a dead organ in its socket. That is the premise in a single picture, and it is also what makes the icon read at 48px: a bright sphere against a dim pink haze, with two dark feelers up where nothing else in the frame has any. The body is composed rather than redrawn (`use: ss.char.dot`), so the icon is always the character the player is actually given. Authored at 512 so the 512 plate bakes 1:1; the `maskable` variant pulls the body in for a round mask.

maskable.description: The same picture with the body inside a round mask's safe zone — Android crops an installed icon to whatever shape the launcher likes, and a feeler is the first thing a circle would take off. The ground stays full-bleed, because that is what the crop is supposed to eat.
